0022600224.text: The Utah Jazz (1-10, 1-5 at home, 5th in the Northwest and 15th in the West) host the Orlando Magic (3-7, 0-4 at home, 11th in the East) in the Jazz's 12th game of the season, with Utah on a nine-game losing streak and Orlando on a one-game winning streak. Utah is without Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain), and Lauri Markkanen (hand fracture), while Keyonte George is day-to-day with an ankle sprain, and Orlando is missing Izaiyah Nelson (ankle surgery), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain), and Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), with Tristan da Silva day-to-day with a calf strain. The Jazz lost both meetings with the Magic in the 2025-26 season (0-2), most recently a 120-117 loss in Orlando on February 7, 2026, and the two teams have not yet played each other this season.
